summary: Project to update the Notes page by adding four new note categories across category tabs and Add/Edit Note modals while keeping existing categories unchanged.

existing_features.title: Update the Notes page category filter tabs to include four new categories: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", displayed alongside the existing tabs (All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other) and styled identically to the existing category tabs.

Update the Add Note modal category dropdown to include four new selectable category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", without changing, removing, or renaming any existing category options.

Ensure the Edit Note modal category dropdown (when editing an existing note) includes the same four new category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", and that existing notes with these categories can be viewed and saved without category validation/type errors.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add four new note categories (LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family) to Notes page category tabs and Add/Edit Note modal dropdowns, matching existing tab styling and keeping existing categories unchanged.
